sources.name: Book Dash
sources.purpose: Open-licensed illustrated picture books for young children (mostly South African languages and English).

evidence.quote: We publish all of our books under a Creative Commons CC BY 4.0 license – our creative volunteers’ gift to the world. Under this license, there is no restriction on what people can do with the books, as long as they acknowledge Book Dash and the original creators.
All of our books are published on our website under a Creative Commons BY 4.0 license

sources.notes: Title pages show credits and ISBN but no licence line; the ebook imprint could not be opened from the agent environment (download needs a browser). Titles are therefore link-only until a human confirms the licence on each title's imprint page.

sources.notes: Reachable on 2026-11-10, but the terms page and per-title licence are rendered by the browser app or need a login; the public story API returned no licence field. Not verified, so no titles are listed.
